messages:
Asha: FYI noticed the dashboard p95 for /v1/complete spiked ~180ms after we shifted 15% traffic to quantized-fallback. p50 unchanged, p99 up a bit. sample-count widget stable. artifact?

Ravi: can you paste the exact prometheus expression? if the query is endpoint-level it could be merging tdigest rollups from different samplers.

Asha: query: quantile_over_time(0.95, request_latency_ms{endpoint=\"/v1/complete\"}[5m]) — no routing tags.

Noah: yep that's the issue. our ingestion strips routing_variant to reduce cardinality; tdigest merges without provenance cause non-linear percentile shifts when route weights change.

Priya: Ops tradeoff documented: drop variant tag to keep dashboards fast. but this bites for tail metrics during rollouts.

Asha: what are mitigation options? we need something that doesn't explode storage.

Ravi: ideas: (a) keep as-is + surface a small warning when recent rollout weight changes detected; (b) store tiny provenance metadata with rollup (counts by variant); (c) enable opt-in higher-card rollups for teams.

Noah: (b) seems sweet. small map like {variant:count} attached to rollup lets UI show split counts and indicate sensitivity. no full high-card timeseries.

Priya: agree. UI can show a little pill next to percentiles: \"merged (n=7.3k)\" and on hover expand to per-variant counts and a note: \"sensitive to recent routing weight changes\".

Asha: backend sketch: Rollup { tdigest_bytes, map<string,int64> sample_counts } — aggregator needs to increment counts by variant when building blobs.

Noah: also include last_weight_change_ts so UI can auto-flag if weight shifted in last X mins.

Ravi: ownership? I'll take proto + aggregator changes. Priya can evaluate storage delta.

Priya: rough estimate: provenance map adds ~50-200 bytes per rollup depending on active variants. multiply by endpoints / retention -> might be manageable. will run numbers after PR.

Noah: UX ask: show orange marker if (a) provenance shows >10% of samples in non-default variant OR (b) last_weight_change < 10m. clicking marker runs quick split query if team opted in.

Asha: also add a console help blurb: \"Why p95 moved during rollouts\" with simple before/after numbers and explanation of tdigest merge sensitivity. customers keep asking.

ops-bot: note: telemetry-provenance feature flagged for staging deploy.

Ravi: plan: open PR with proto change + aggregator hook, add feature flag to enable provenance metadata, UI reads counts and shows pill. keep opt-in per-organization for full per-variant rollups.

Asha: thanks. action items: Ravi proto + PR, Priya cost estimate, Noah UI mock for pill + marker copy, Asha write blurb. Tagging folks: @Ravi @Priya @Noah

Priya: noted. will POST cost estimate next update.

Asha: cool. i'll attach the sample timeline and screenshots later in thread.
